cases.prompt: Write the postmortem for INC-2291, stable since 2026-09-20 11:40 UTC. Evidence: 09:12 deploy of payments-api v4.8 changed the DB connection pool from 50 to 5 (PR #7712, reviewed; its description did not mention the pool change); 09:19 p95 checkout latency alert paged on-call; 09:31 on-call acknowledged; 09:58 SEV2 declared; 10:40 rollback started; 11:05 rollback complete; 11:40 error rate back to baseline. Logs show 3,812 failed checkout attempts, about 9% of attempts in the window. In Slack two responders disagree on whether paging config delayed the acknowledgment. Responders reviewed the timeline draft yesterday.
sourceAnchors: Build a timestamped factual timeline with source confidence
Explain why defenses did not prevent or limit impact
